question: How do I create a student account on StudentHub?
answer: Click on the Register link in the navigation menu. Fill in your name, college email, mobile number, course, year of study, and create a secure password.

question: What should I do if I forget my password?
answer: During the current phase, you can contact the campus IT Helpdesk or submit an inquiry through the Contact Us page to request a password reset.

question: Can I update my registered contact details?
answer: Yes. Once logged in, visit your Profile page to update your phone number, alternate email address, and residential address.

question: How can I view my enrolled courses and attendance?
answer: Your Student Dashboard lists all currently registered subjects, credit points, semester breakdown, and real-time attendance percentages.

question: When are semester exam admit cards published?
answer: Admit cards are generally released two weeks before the commencement of end-semester examinations on the student dashboard notices.

question: Who is eligible to participate in college events?
answer: All active students enrolled across any undergraduate or postgraduate program are eligible. Check each event listing on the Events page for specific criteria.

question: Will I receive a certificate for attending workshops?
answer: Yes, all registered participants who complete workshop and seminar sessions will receive verified digital certificates issued by the organizing department.

question: Where can I report a campus grievance or facility issue?
answer: You can use the Feedback page to submit detailed feedback or visit the Dean of Student Welfare office during standard campus hours.

question: How do I contact the college administration office?
answer: Head over to the Contact page for administrative office hours, department phone extensions, official mailing addresses, and location maps.
